wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/count_remaining.sh: #!/bin/zsh
# Counts code files that STILL carry conflict markers. `git status` keeps a resolved file listed
# as UU until it is staged, so it is the wrong thing to measure progress with.
cd /Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature || exit 1
n=0
git status --short \
  | grep '^UU' \
  | sed 's/^.. //' \
  | grep -v 'docs/internals/builtins/\|docs/php/builtins' \
  | while read -r f; do
      if grep -q '^<<<<<<<' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '%s\n' "$f"
      fi
    done
